p1_risk.description: Prometheus scrape targets in docker/prometheus.yml point to gRPC service ports (e.g., boutique-cart:7070, boutique-product:3550). Online Boutique v0.9.0 uses gRPC over HTTP/2 on these ports — they do NOT serve Prometheus /metrics endpoints. Prometheus will fail to scrape all boutique service targets.
p1_risk.evidence: docker/prometheus.yml scrapes boutique-cart:7070 but cart uses REDIS_ADDR=boutique-redis:6379 and is a gRPC server. The JAEGER_SERVICE_ADDR env var confirms observability goes via Jaeger, not Prometheus.
resolution_options: Add OpenTelemetry Collector with Prometheus exporter to bridge OTEL → Prometheus metrics
Add a per-service Prometheus exporter sidecar
Use Jaeger trace data as the primary telemetry source and derive latency/error metrics from traces
Use cadvisor for container-level metrics (CPU, memory, network bytes)
p1_risk.status: UNRESOLVED — requires live testbed deployment to confirm

pipeline_stages.name: raw_collection
pipeline_stages.description: Query Prometheus /api/v1/query_range and Jaeger /api/traces for each Δt window
pipeline_stages.output: List[Metric] objects with service_id, metric_name, value, timestamp, collection_lag_s
pipeline_stages.note: collection_lag_s must be < Δt/2 = 5s to avoid window misassignment

pipeline_stages.name: normalization
pipeline_stages.description: Map raw metric names to RIFT variable names (lat_p99, err_rate, rps, cpu_pct, mem_pct)
pipeline_stages.output: Dict[service_id, Dict[metric_name, float]] per Δt window
pipeline_stages.validation: NaN/Inf values must be flagged and handled (current gap: Metric.value has no NaN guard)

pipeline_stages.name: time_slice_alignment
pipeline_stages.description: Assign each observation to time window: window_id = floor(timestamp / delta_t). If collection_lag_s > delta_t/2, assign to window N+1.

pipeline_stages.name: g_t_construction
pipeline_stages.description: Build G_T from aligned observations. Add CALL_GRAPH edges from service topology. Add AUTOREGRESSIVE self-edges.
pipeline_stages.output: G_T: NetworkX DiGraph with CausalVariable nodes
pipeline_stages.provenance: Each node carries service_id + metric_name + time_index traceable to source query

provenance_requirement.description: Every CausalVariable in G_T must be traceable to its source telemetry.
provenance_requirement.provenance_chain: CausalVariable.var_id → metric_name → prometheus_query → scrape_job → service endpoint
provenance_requirement.implementation_note: src/rift/models/data_models.py CausalVariable has service_id + metric_name + time_index fields

validation_tests.trigger: Service unreachable; Prometheus returns no data for that service
validation_tests.expected_behavior: No CausalVariable nodes created for that service in G_T; anomaly subgraph may be empty for that service; RIFT abstains if no anomaly detected
Observation reassigned to window N+1; alignment_log entry written; causal edges may span incorrect windows

validation_tests.trigger: NaN or Inf in metric value
validation_tests.expected_behavior: KNOWN GAP: Metric.value: float has no NaN guard in data_models.py. NaN will propagate to anomaly detection. Should be handled with explicit guard.
window_id = floor(t/delta_t) is miscomputed; causal edges connect wrong temporal slices; G_T structure invalid
validation_tests.mitigation: Use NTP or Docker clock sharing (--pid host or chrony container)

validation_tests.trigger: Service container restarts; telemetry disappears for 1-3 windows then returns
validation_tests.expected_behavior: Gap windows have no CausalVariable nodes; AUTOREGRESSIVE edges skip gap; anomaly detection triggered on return if metrics spike
Three consecutive windows with no observations; G_T has structural holes; anomaly subgraph may be empty; RIFT should abstain rather than attribute based on stale data

honest_caveat: Telemetry pipeline specification is complete. Live validation requires Online Boutique deployment on Linux. The P1 Prometheus/gRPC port mismatch must be resolved before real metrics can flow.
